arabic text: LASHE AUN O MOHAMED AAKA LAYE JO RAN SE\nZAINAB NE UTHHAYE HATHHO SHUKRE ILAHI MEIN
english translation text: WHEN THE BODIES OF AUN AND MUHAMMAD WERE BROUGHT TO THE TENTS\nZAINAB LIFTED HER HANDS IN GRATITUDE (TO ALLAH)

arabic text: KAHAN HO TUM, ALI AKBER ZAARA AWAAZ TO DENA\nAKELA REHGAYAA HAI ALI KA LAL MAIDAN MEIN,
english translation text: WHERE ARE YOU, O’ AKBAR, CALL OUT TO ME\nALI’S SON IS LEFT ALONE IN THE BATTLEFIELD

arabic text: LASHE ALI AKBER NAHIN UTHTEE HAI AQAA SE,\nYA ALI ZARA NAJAF SE UTHHKE AYEE O MAIDAN MEIN
english translation text: MY MASTER (HUSSAIN) CANNOT CARRY THE CORPSE OF HIS SON AKBAR\nO ALI, COME FROM NAJAF TO THE BATTLEFIELD TO HIS AID

arabic text: ZAMEEN E KARBALA USKO ZARAA ARAAM SE RAKHNA\nSULAYA HAI ASGER KO TERE DAMAN ME
english translation text: OH LAND OF KARBALA, TAKE TENDER CARE OF ASGHAR,\nHE HAS BEEN LAID TO REST TENDERLY IN YOUR LAP

arabic text: TUM NADE ALI PADKE JALTI KHAKH PE SONA\nSAKINA GHABRA NAHI HUM AYENGE KHWABA MEIN
english translation text: RECITE NAADE ALI AND SLEEP ON THE SCORCHING GROUND\nFEAR NOT SAKINA I WILL COME TO COMFORT YOU IN YOUR DREAMS

arabic text: GIREBA CHAKH SIRPE KHAKH ZAINAB KE BANDHE BAZU\nSHAMEIN\nBHALA PEHCHANTI HIND ISE HALE PARE
english translation text: WITH TORN CLOTHES, DUST IN HER HAIR AND BOUND HANDS,\nHOW WILL HIND RECOGNIZE ZAINAB IN THIS\nDISTRESSED STATE

arabic text: LOOTA TAU KARBALA MEIN MUSLMANO NE KYA LOOTA\nALI KI BETIYO KAN CHADRE AYE HAI SAMA MEIN
english translation text: IF THE ‘MUSLIMS’ WERE TO PLUNDER THE HOUSE OF ZAHRA IN KARBALA, WHAT DID THEY DECIDE TO LOOT?\nALI’ DAUGHTERS VEILS ARE INCLUDED IN THE WAR BOOTY
